name: video-player
title: Custom Video Player
description: Minimal cinematic video player with timed controls, scrubbing, and mute state

changelog.summary: Removed public videoSrc/poster/src media controls and duplicate muted/showControls entries; merged behavior and controls into a single working controls group.

Added videoSrc, poster, autoPlay, startMuted, and showCloseButton as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested prop names (src, muted, showControls) didn't match the real component API, so they were renamed to match what VideoPlayerComp actually accepts.

Removed the continuous rAF progress loop (~60 setState/sec while playing); the progress bar now rides the native timeupdate events with a linear CSS transition for smoothness, cut during scrubbing for 1:1 pointer tracking.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Shows the close button on the player.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounds the player frame when not fullscreen.

props.name: preserveAspectRatio
props.description: Uses object-contain instead of object-cover for the video.

props.name: hideControlsDelay
props.description: Delay before controls auto-hide, in milliseconds.
